executive_summary: Revise. Candidate and handoff byte bindings pass, all 51 persisted evidence hashes pass, and the feedback remediation correctly sets JOLTS to zero rope weight and caps Warsh at 2.0. However, the candidate still contains the unauditable exact JOLTS values in its explanatory reason text, contrary to the remediation requirement that the candidate contain no such exact claims. This remains a material audit and P&L-control failure.

findings.issue: The remediation removes the exact JOLTS values from the data fields, but the candidate still contains the exact unauditable values 7.271 and 7.182 in the JOLTS reason text. The explicit feedback requirement was that the candidate contain no unauditable exact 7.271/7.182 claims or derived deltas, not merely that those values be excluded from the displayed data object.
findings.evidence: The persisted BLS JOLTS release is HTTP 200 and states July openings were little changed at rounded 7.3 million; the persisted recollection metadata records contains_7_271=false and contains_7_182=false. Independent byte inspection confirms the candidate contains both strings in the JOLTS reason, while the candidate SHA-256 matches candidate.sha256 and pm-handoff.json.
findings.pnl_impact: A downstream consumer or reviewer can still read the exact unsupported values and infer the removed miss/month-over-month arithmetic. That preserves false precision in the labour-demand signal and can distort Fed hike-versus-hold risk assessment, event hedge sizing, and front-end rates or equity-duration positioning.
